name: nys-workers-comp-hub
displayName: New York State Workers' Compensation Hub
description: New York State workers' compensation in Claude: benefit calculators (AWW, weekly rates and the max/min by date of accident, SLU, LWEC, CCP awards, Section 32 splits, Burns liens, apportionment), formulas with citations, the glossary, plain-language explainers, WCB forms, case law from a verified library, a NYC doctor finder, eleven free workflow skills (including beta hearing prep and hearing-notes posting), sending cases to your Comp Desk Pro Workspace, and posting the hearing notes you format there into your case-management system. In Claude Code it also adds The Comp Desk suite: a desk beside the chat with the drafts waiting for your review and every Hub figure with its inputs, laid out the way you choose.

open_desk.title: When the desk opens
open_desk.description: offer: the row above the prompt offers the desk the first time the Hub returns a figure in a session. on-hub-work: it opens by itself at the first Hub work in a session, where the screen is wide enough. on-start: it opens once at the start of each session, where the screen is wide enough. /comp-desk always opens it. Layout, density, client names, look and motion are set in the desk's Customize view.

send_guard.title: Ask before named sends
send_guard.description: sends: a connector tool call whose name says it sends something outside Claude (an email, a message, a post, a comment, a new thread, issue or review, a push, a deploy or a release), and the Hub's Pro Workspace writes, wait for your own approval, even in auto mode. This applies in every Claude Code session on this computer, not only Hub work; where nobody can approve (a scheduled task or a background agent) the call is refused. A send your own settings hook makes is refused too, since nobody is asked about it; a settings hook of your organization's keeps its own rules. It reads tool names, so a shell command, a browser click or a general-purpose connector tool is not covered: Claude Code's own permission prompts apply there. sends-and-writes: also asks before a connector creates or changes a record once you work with the Hub. hub-only: asks only before the Hub's Pro Workspace writes.

working_conventions.title: Hub working conventions for Claude
working_conventions.description: Adds a short section to Claude's instructions: Hub figures with their inputs, drafts for your review, nothing sent without your yes. It applies only to New York workers' compensation work.

menu_rows.title: Right-click rows (desktop app)
menu_rows.description: Rows in the desktop app's right-click menu: look up a selected term, date or WCB form with the Hub, or copy a figure with its inputs.
